papers.title_en: Dynamic geometry remapping of neural activity within frontal and subcortical areas during decision-making
papers.authors: Stoll, F. M., Valluru, N., Rudebeck, P. H.
papers.evidence: 决策过程中额叶皮层神经几何动态重映射反映执行功能加工.
papers.tldr: 决策中，大脑如何动态编码竞争选项属性以支持灵活选择尚未阐明。本研究在猕猴执行决策任务时记录其九个额叶和皮层下区的16,495个神经元，发现全脑神经活动在编码不同选项属性时呈现动态波动，其模式紧密追踪决策进程，且波动强度随决策难度增大而增强。该表征非绑定选项属性，而是区域和属性特异的神经几何重映射。这揭示了动态几何重组是决策计算的核心机制，为理解决策提供新原理。
papers.abstract_en: Decision-making involves dynamic evaluation of competing options. Recording 16,495 neurons across nine frontal and subcortical areas in macaques revealed brain-wide fluctuations between encoding the attributes of available options. These dynamic representations track deliberation and scale with decision difficulty. Instead of binding attribute information of different options together, our analyses show that these representations are associated with dynamic area- and attribute-specific changes in neural geometry.
